beats.text: To recap. State the basis before you compare fuels: per mole, per gram, or per useful energy. To compare emissions for a task, normalise to the same useful output, which brings in efficiency. Say which boundary an emission claim uses. And remember that renewable isn't the same as sustainable.
Closing recall. Name two reasons a renewable biofuel might not be sustainable.

For example: its crop competes with food for land or uses a lot of water, or methane leaks from its production, or processing relies on fossil energy. Next episode is our first exam workshop, on fuels and combustion.
